docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This script uses the pyvisa library to communicate with external hardware over VISA protocol (e.g., GPIB, USB, RS232). It’s used to query device identity and test connectivity.

docs.title: This script sets up a Data Acquisition (DAQ) task using NI-DAQmx in
It defines which channels to use, the timing of the acquisition,
and how the DAQ system starts and stops.
docs.text: import nidaqmx task = nidaqmx.Task() task.ai_channels.add_ai_voltage_chan("Dev1/ai0", min_val=-10.0, max_val=10.0) task.timing.cfg_samp_clk_timing( * rate=1000, * sample_mode=nidaqmx.constants.AcquisitionType.CONTINUOUS ) Configure the task for continuous acquisition at 1000 samples per second. Task Execution task.start()
